name: Time-Varying Scalar Field (TVSF) Rendering with Vector Quantization (HAVS)
definition: A GPU-based volume rendering method for time-varying scalar fields on unstructured meshes (tetrahedral) that uses Vector Quantization (VQ) to compress scalar data and a paging mechanism to handle arbitrary time steps without rendering stalls.
summary: HAVS with VQ is a GPU-based volume rendering method for time-varying scalar fields on unstructured meshes that prevents rendering stalls by combining hardware-assisted visibility sorting with vector quantization compression.
